fixed.summary: A node graph's hex node is cut by its corners (`corner-shape: bevel` on a 25% / 50% radius) instead of a `clip-path`, so it no longer clips its own caption below it (the card run map's Event and Treasure), and its rim follows the hexagon. The graph's well sizes as a box does, across and down its container (no less than a graph's height), instead of a fixed 420 × 288, so it no longer overflows a phone.
